items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: I had worked with John before, we were good buddies.

ctx.x: And Skitch Henderson was on that.

Skitch Henderson’s band, yeah. And Mel Torme I’m almost certain it was Mel, was on the show and Carson is a big jazz lover and so Mel Torme was a God to him you know. And Mel Torme was on before me, and then they told me, “This is your first shot so you don’t go to the panel, do your stand-up and walk out.” So I did something very hip. Maybe it was the fourth trumpet, I don’t know what I did but Carson actually came and got me physically and took me to the panel. And everybody’s going, “Whoa man, you are made,…
the routine in an office to somebody so they could make sure, the continuity, they could make sure they didn’t have to censor something.
